import zipfile,re,os
p=os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/best_awards_acl.xlsx')
z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)
try: ss=[re.sub('<[^>]+>','',s) for s in re.findall(r'<si>(.*?)</si>',z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml').decode('utf8'),re.S)]
except KeyError: ss=[]
n=sorted(m for m in z.namelist() if m.startswith('xl/worksheets/sheet'))[0]
sh=z.read(n).decode('utf8')
for rm in re.finditer(r'<row[^>]*>(.*?)</row>',sh,re.S):
    out=[]
    for cm in re.finditer(r'<c r="([A-Z]+)\d+"([^>]*)>(.*?)</c>',rm.group(1),re.S):
        col,attrs,inner=cm.groups()
        v=re.search(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>',inner)
        t=re.search(r'<t[^>]*>([^<]*)</t>',inner)
        val=t.group(1) if t else (ss[int(v.group(1))] if (v and 't="s"' in attrs) else (v.group(1) if v else ''))
        out.append(col+'='+val[:26])
    print(' ~ '.join(out))
print('SIZE',os.path.getsize(p))
PYEOF
